trades.reasoning: All four confirmation signals present (bullish RSI, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) on a risk-on day, matching the institutional-participation setup from strategy memory.

decisions.briefing: Markets were risk-on today with NASDAQ +1.3% and S&P 500 +0.6%. Cash is below the usual $500 buy threshold and this isn't an extreme risk-on day (NASDAQ +2%+), so we made one disciplined buy in SLS, which shows full multi-signal confirmation, rather than force-deploying into weaker setups.

market_education.summary_en: Broad market gains today were led by NASDAQ, up 1.3%, outpacing the S&P 500's 0.6% gain, suggesting growth and tech-oriented names drove the rally more than the broader index. No single dominant headline stood out in today's screened data, consistent with a broad-based risk-on move rather than one catalyst-driven event. Momentum names with volume surges, like SLS and ONDS, saw outsized participation relative to the index-level gain.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚，納斯達克指數上升1.3%，升幅超越標普500指數的0.6%，顯示今日升勢主要由科技及成長股帶動，多於整體大盤。今日篩選數據中未見單一主導性頭條新聞，反映這是一次較廣泛的風險偏好（risk-on）行情，而非單一事件驅動。個別具備成交量放大的動力股，例如SLS及ONDS，升幅明顯跑贏大盤。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of buying on a single bullish clue, traders often wait until several independent signals line up — like RSI in a healthy range, a MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge. When all of these agree, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest (not just noise) is pushing the stock higher.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 與其只憑單一看漲訊號就買入，交易者通常會等待多個獨立訊號同時出現，例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD出現黃金交叉、股價高於移動平均線，以及成交量放大。當這些訊號同時成立時，代表推動股價上升的是真實買盤，而非單純的市場雜訊。
